Name: Crops Anytime Anywhere
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Grow crops & fruit trees in any season and location, including on grass/dirt tiles you normally couldn't till.
Description:
Grow crops & fruit trees in any season and location, including on grass/dirt tiles you normally couldn't till. You can optionally configure the seasons, locations, and tillable tile types.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/develop/CropsAnytimeAnywhere/docs/screenshot.gif)

Note: The mod doesn't change store inventories, so you can only buy seeds during their usual seasons.

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

You can optionally [customise the mod settings](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/CropsAnytimeAnywhere#configure) (including which seasons allow any crops).

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer (must be installed by the main player).
* No known mod conflicts.

Pairs well with [Winter Grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1601) (grass grows in every season).

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
